'''''Corellian Seaside''''' was a landscape [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was created by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] known as [[Mi'raj]] and depicted a [[Star/Legends|sun]]-lit [[Ocean/Legends|seaside]] [[Beach/Legends|beach]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Several [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] were also visible on the beach.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Corellian Seaside'' is a painting that appears in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massive multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released for the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] in [[2003]], where it can be used in the player character's home as decoration. The painting was added to the game as part of the "rare loot system" in the ''Hotfix 17.10'' game update on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. The system allows players to receive increasingly rare items as loot from any defeated enemy in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
